nom: Thayers Hydrating Milky Facial Cleanser with Snow Mushroom and Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin loved the cleanser despite it being marketed for dry/normal skin, while another with oily skin was advised against it because it did not remove makeup well.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most consistently report relief from tightness and flakiness, describing skin left soft and hydrated rather than stripped, though one reviewer with dry sensitive skin still found her skin drier than expected afterward.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin (oily in spots, dry in others) reported no issues from either side and a clean, non-breakout result.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation, redness, or tight/dry feeling, citing the fragrance-free formula as key; one dry/sensitive reviewer nonetheless felt post-wash dryness.
segments.mature: A reviewer using it alongside the Thayers toner for mature skin reports increased hydration and refreshed skin.
segments.normal: The product is described by several reviewers as suited to normal skin, with one noting she found it 'not ideal for my skin type' but still fine to use.

concerns.aging: Only a single mention ties the cleanser to mature skin, reporting more hydrated, refreshed skin after pairing with the matching toner; no other aging-specific claims appear.
concerns.dehydration: Dehydration is the most repeated concern addressed, with numerous reviewers saying it resolved dryness, tightness, and dehydrated skin; a couple of reviewers still felt drier or not sufficiently cleansed afterward.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers specifically note reduced redness and calmer skin, and several others describe general soothing of irritated or inflamed skin with no reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers state the cleanser does not strip or disrupt the skin barrier, leaving skin calm and comfortable; no barrier-related complaints appear.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers with occasional acne or hormonal breakouts report clearing or no worsening after use, but one reviewer experienced severe cystic acne breakouts twice and attributed them directly to the product.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers note the cleanser helped keep breakouts at bay or cleared minor blemishes within days, though this is inconsistent with the one report of a bad breakout.
concerns.oiliness: Reports on oiliness are mixed: some oily-adjacent or combination-skin reviewers say it did not leave residue or excess oil, while one reviewer felt it left an oily-feeling film and another said it did not suit oily skin for makeup removal.

aspects.libelle: Poor makeup removal, needs double cleanse

extraits.texte: I had a TERRIBLE breakout shortly after I started using this. I quit using it for a little while because I didn't feel like it was really getting my face clean at night. My face cleared up but I didn't really make the connection (I do have hormonal acne that gets triggered by so many things). But then I started using it again in the mornings (because I'm not worried about trying to wash off makeup in the mornings) and had another breakout. I mean, really bad cystic acne. So I realized this was the problem and threw it out. If you have perfectly clear skin this might be fine but if you have ANY issues with acne at all this is probably not the one for you.

extraits.titre: Hydrating & milky but not for makeup removal
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This cleanser is nice and creamy and leaves your skin feeling moisturized but I'm not sure I'd recommend it for anyone with oily skin or if you're trying to remove makeup. It doesn't seem to dissolve my makeup very well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Thayers Hydrating Milky cleanser is a unique facial wash. The product is creamy white. It is dispensed through a twist about spout pump and one or two pumps is enough for washing. There is no lather. It is just a lotion like cream that I spread to my premoisted face. There is no fragrance which is good for sensitive noses. I have dry sensitive skin and did not experience discomfort or breakouts. However, I just did not feel like my face was squeaky clean. It just felt like I washed my face with light lotion. Additionally, my skin felt dryer than expected. I did not have oily feel on my face. I did follow up immediately with a good face serum and moisturizer to combat flaky dryness after washing with this product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this daily in the morning to wash my face and it cleans REALLY well. Almost makes me worry it cleans too well. I have combo skin where I'm oily in spots and dry in others. I didn't notice any issues with either and I had a clean slate after use. My skin is squeaky clean after use, literally. My skincare products soak in pretty quickly with use and have noticed my skin hasn't been breaking out as bad (thanks hormones). It does not foam up, but just feels like an oil on your skin. It comes off quickly and effectively. One pump will clean my whole face and neck with easy so I know this will laaaaast.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Packaging is great, love the red pump. I deal with dry skin and this cleanser feels great on my skin, no more super dry skin. While washing it doesn't get bubbly so I feel like my skin doesn't get washed good but it does! No breakouts with this cleanser but my skin isn't super sensitive.

I love Thayer's products and this Hydratung Milky Cleanser with Snow Mushroom and Hyaluronic Acid didn't disappoint! The cleanser is easy to use and non-foaming. It comes in a pump bottle. It's sulfate, paraben and fragrance free so it works great on my sensitive skin. And it's cruelty free! Not only does it cleanse my facial skin well, but it hydrates, cushions and helps maintain a healthy skin barrier. It leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and moisturized. I would absolutely buy this and continue using it! I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest feedback.

As a very dry/sensative skin girly I've tried so many cleansers throughout the years that would always leave my skin feeling tight and very irritated. It wasn't until a couple of weeks ago that I discovered that Im supposed to be using a non foaming cleanser for my skin type so I decided to pick this one up. Right away I felt a difference and can't believe it took me this long to figure it out. This cleanser is super creamy and soothing on the skin and works great as my second cleanse after oil cleansing. Thank you thayers for creating this formula!
